dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Multiple circular 'O' structures exhibit high-intensity white perimeters with sharp gradient transitions to low-intensity dark cores. A prominent tri-lobed cluster in the upper-right section shows interconnected high-contrast boundaries with jagged exterior edges.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: Moderate density of solid high-intensity pixel clusters concentrated primarily along the lower ventral edge and the posterior-dorsal ridge, appearing as localized points without internal gradient transitions.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: Centroids of the three most prominent annuli in the mid-lateral region form an obtuse scalene triangle, while the centroids of the upper-right clover-like cluster form a secondary compact equilateral arrangement.

other_distinctive_markers: A highly unique cluster of three interconnected annuli forming a tri-lobed 'cloverleaf' configuration is present in the upper-right quadrant of the visible lateral field.
